description: Turn a PDF, scan or photo of a page into Markdown with headings, lists and tables, without a language model. Uses the PDF's own text, or OCR for a scan.

file.description: The file, base64-encoded (a data: URL also works). Up to 5 MB.

lang.description: OCR languages joined by +, such as eng+hin. Default eng.

ocr.description: PDF: auto (default) uses OCR only when the PDF has no text.

name: read_document_as_markdown
title: Read document as markdown
